title: Content Security Policy — Companion Files
description: Runnable CSP toolkit: per-request nonce middleware, a violation report endpoint that accepts both Reporting API and legacy report-uri payloads, a helmet config, and the documented Next.js middleware + Server Component nonce pattern.
description_es: Kit ejecutable de CSP: middleware de nonce por request, endpoint de reportes que acepta payloads de la Reporting API y del legado report-uri, config de helmet y el patrón documentado de Next.js con middleware + Server Components.
